statement: S103 (D31/F12, owner authorisation item 5): before retiring the Phase253 local bound reader (MIN_BEFORE, MAX_BEFORE, MIN_AFTER, MAX_AFTER), its readings were compared with the quantity-knowledge reader (quantityBound) on every quantity of the 206 regression requests and the request-path test texts, and phrase by phrase over the local reader's vocabulary. Counts only; the request texts are in the regression sets.
material: 206 regression requests (spent; scripts/s83-advice-regression.mjs) and string literals of tests/phase253_advice, s85_safety_and_quantities, s102_rule_lifecycle, s103_request_semantics, phase248_advisory_journey, s80_request_coverage
sharedOnlyExample: 'no louder than 44 dB' (a level the local reader never read)

vocabulary.cause: the shared reader treated the dot of 'min.'/'max.' as a sentence break and had no property-word prefix; 12 phrases were not in the pack
vocabulary.change: qk.2.5 adds the phrases and boundPropertyWords to language.en; quantityBound skips abbreviation dots; after the change the shared reader covers all 49 local phrases (scratch script bound-vocab.mjs, re-run in tests/s103_request_semantics.test.ts#one bound reader reads every phrase of the retired local reader)

decision: RQ01 and RQ02 superseded by RQ03 and RQ04; the B-READERS contests removed (no second reader can disagree any more)
